hero.title: Yaralıoğlu Yatırım Ticaret Ltd.
hero.sub: A corporate structure focused on sports culture, performance discipline and social impact.
hero.body: Built on founder Selcuk Yaralioglu's national athlete, coaching and academic background, our approach turns athlete development, healthy living culture and institutional partnerships into measurable long-term impact. Our multidisciplinary model integrates training, performance, nutrition, physiotherapy, rehabilitation and recovery under one system.

intro.title: We see sport as character building, not only performance
intro.p1: Yaralioglu began with founder Selcuk Yaralioglu's early responsibilities as a national athlete and coach. From the first facility onward, combat sports, performance training and crossfit were combined with sports nutrition, physiotherapy, rehabilitation and recovery to build one of the early multidisciplinary models in the field.
intro.p2: Today, we scale this approach through academy development and institutional project collaboration. Our priority is not short-term commercial gain, but helping children and individuals experience the transformative value of sport and supporting the growth of healthy, disciplined and resilient people.

hero.title: Corporate
hero.desc: How we sustain long-term impact through founder background, values and an institutional operating model.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.p1: Yaralioglu was established through founder Selcuk Yaralioglu's vision rooted in national athlete and national coaching experience. From the first facility, combat sports, performance training and crossfit were integrated with sports nutrition, physiotherapy, rehabilitation and recovery, forming a pioneering multidisciplinary model.
profile.p2: Developed through field experience, academic progression and international exposure, this model now operates as a sustainable and measurable structure open to institutional collaboration.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To scale sport's transformative impact on individuals and society through institutional standards, contributing to healthier and stronger generations.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To deliver sustainable development-focused solutions for athletes, young people and partners by combining academy systems, performance training and integrated health support in one framework.

integrity.title: Integrity and commitment
integrity.body: We keep promises and execution quality aligned at every stage of delivery.

capital.title: Sustainability
capital.body: We prioritize long-term impact over short-term visibility gains.

excel.title: Scientific development
excel.body: Training and development processes are supported by academic knowledge, measurement and continuous improvement.

stakeholder.title: Social responsibility
stakeholder.body: We treat sport not only as competition but as a path to character, discipline and life skills.

management.title: Management approach
management.p1: Our management model combines field-proven experience with structured planning. Program quality, athlete safety, development tracking and team coordination are core priorities. Every project is evaluated through sustainability and measurable-outcome criteria.
management.p2: In institutional collaborations, we work with transparent communication, clear scope and realistic timelines to keep the process understandable for every stakeholder.

strategy.title: Corporate perspective & long-term strategy
strategy.p1: Our long-term strategy is to strengthen the academy model, scale multidisciplinary performance methods and deliver high-standard implementation in institutional projects.
strategy.p2: With a vision shaped by national and international experience, we aim to build an expandable structure that creates lasting value for sports culture in our country.

hero.title: Activities
hero.desc: Four strategic pillars define how we create value, serve partners and compound reputation in competitive categories.

fitness.title: Sports & Fitness Solutions
fitness.body: We architect and govern premium wellness environments where program quality, equipment lifecycle and talent standards reinforce brand equity. Capabilities span concept development, operational audits, trainer excellence frameworks and member journey design calibrated for discerning audiences.
fitness.panelNote: This section will highlight the company's strategic activity area with photography and infographics in the final production cycle.

facility.title: Facility Operations
facility.body: From high-traffic athletic venues to corporate amenity floors, we administer preventive maintenance schedules, vendor performance scorecards and emergency readiness protocols. The aim is uninterrupted uptime, brand-consistent aesthetics and predictable cost structures.
facility.panelNote: This section will highlight the company's strategic activity area with photography and infographics in the final production cycle.

trade.title: Trade & Distribution
trade.body: Selective import, wholesale and channel partnerships are structured around contractual clarity, inventory discipline and ethical sourcing checkpoints. We prioritize relationships that scale with transparent Service Level Agreements and mutual margin integrity.
trade.panelNote: This section will highlight the company's strategic activity area with photography and infographics in the final production cycle.

investment.title: Investment & Business Development
investment.body: Our investment posture is deliberate: we engage where operational insight can be applied, governance can be strengthened and exit pathways remain realistic. Business development supports joint ventures, tuck-in acquisitions and platform expansions screened against group risk appetite.

hero.title: Investments
hero.desc: How we deploy attention and capital—with patience, governance and measurable accountability.

philosophy.title: Investment philosophy
philosophy.body: We favor situations where operational expertise is a differentiator, downside is understood and upside is driven by execution—not speculation. Capital follows clarity: strategy, organizational readiness and risk mitigation must be in place before material commitment.

growth.title: Long-term growth approach
growth.body: Growth is staged across horizons—12-month operational levers, 24–36 month market expansion and multi-year platform bets. Each horizon carries explicit KPIs, review cadence and optional exit criteria to prevent inertia.

InvestmentsPage.portfolioLead: Illustrative initiatives below communicate evaluation categories; confidential projects remain undisclosed until appropriate.

p1.body: A multi-phase initiative upgrading facility systems, digital member touchpoints and analytics infrastructure across core assets.

p2.title: Selective distribution expansion
